title: Test 13 — Move the cell following a defined path like a spiral or triangle, or a known shape
agent_prompt: Stimulate a cell to follow a clockwise spiral trajectory. Identify the destination point where the cell must arrive and begin the stimulation. Take an image every 30 seconds using the phase-contrast channel. Also record the trajectory of the cell centre in a CSV file with the following format: cell_id, stimulation_time, x-position, y-position. Save the images from the two channels and the merged images in separate folders. Display all the images as well as the cell trajectory in the Napari GUI. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Images of the stimulated cells in phase-contrast channel
Merged phase-contrast and stimulation mask images
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
